# Resize Video

- Route: `/tools/resize-video`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `resize-video`

## Summary

Change a video resolution — scale to 1080p, 720p, 480p, or any custom width and height. (Video tools)

## Details

Resizing changes a video resolution — make a 4K clip 1080p, shrink to 720p for the web, or hit an exact pixel size a platform requires. The Media Manipulator video resizer scales your video to the dimensions you choose, preserving the aspect ratio by default, and exports a clean MP4.
### What it does
- Scales a video to a target width and/or height.
- Preserves aspect ratio by default (leave one dimension blank to auto-scale).
- Downscales to shrink the file or upscales to fit a target size.
- Exports MP4 (H.264 + AAC) by default.
### How to use it
1. Upload your video: Pick the clip you want at a different size.
2. Set the size: Enter a width and/or height in pixels.
3. Resize: FFmpeg scales the video and re-encodes it.
4. Download: Save the resized video.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, mkv, webm, avi, m4v
- Output: mp4, webm, mov, mkv
- Resizing re-encodes; MP4 output uses H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart. Max 4096 px per side.
### Technical details
- Leave one dimension blank to scale proportionally and keep the original aspect ratio.
- Keep "Preserve aspect ratio" on to fit within the box without stretching when both dimensions are set.
- Resizing re-encodes; MP4 output uses H.264 + AAC + yuv420p + faststart. Max 4096 px per side.
### Use cases
- Shrink for the web: Drop 4K to 1080p or 720p for faster pages.
- Hit a target size: Match a platform spec exactly.
- Reduce file size: Lower resolution to cut the bytes.
- Standardize footage: Bring clips to one resolution.
### FAQ
Q: How do I resize a video?
A: Upload it, set a target width and/or height, and download the resized video.
Q: How do I change the resolution to 720p?
A: Set the height to 720 and leave the width blank to scale proportionally.
Q: Will resizing keep the aspect ratio?
A: Yes — leave one dimension blank, or keep "Preserve aspect ratio" on so the video is not stretched.
Q: Can I upscale a video?
A: You can scale up to a larger size, but upscaling cannot add detail that was not captured.

## Routing

When to send a visitor here: Send visitors here when they want a different resolution, such as "make this 720p", "scale 4K down to 1080p" or a custom width and height, keeping the aspect ratio by default.
When to send them elsewhere: Cutting away edges or bars is Crop Video (crop-video). To shrink the file while keeping the resolution use Compress Video (compress-video); to restore detail in a short low-resolution clip with AI use AI Video Restoration (ai-video-restoration).
Related tools: crop-video (change framing instead of scale); compress-video (smaller file at same resolution); rotate-video (fix orientation); ai-video-restoration (AI upscaling of a short clip)
